Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or consulting projects? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies architectural expertise at scale. About the Role 10x.team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are looking for knowledgeable architects based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered architectural systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to architectural design, building regulations, project workflows, and practical aspects of architectural work - Evaluate AI responses for technical accuracy, practicality, and compliance with real-world requirements - Draft realistic architectural scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. architect, client, project manager, contractor) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak reasoning in AI-generated architectural content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated content, ensuring it reflects true architectural reasoning, authentic design documentation, and practical procedures. Rather than conducting traditional architectural work, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about architectural processes at scale. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the architectural expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. bloomon-bloomon:lever:b6e1e7ad-fbaa-45cf.title: Supply Chain Lead
bloomon-bloomon:lever:b6e1e7ad-fbaa-45cf.description: Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows. We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us. Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe. Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 🛠️ Procurement Team @ Bloom & Wild Group You’ll be joining the engine room of Bloom & Wild’s fastest-growing categories. While we are known for our flowers, our Procurement team provides the operational and supply chain foundation for our non-horticultural range. From fresh-baked treats and luxury hamper components to home, lifestyle, and the essential packaging that delivers the "wow" moment. Our team is divided into two clear pillars: Strategic Procurement and Stock Planning. As the Supply Chain Lead, you will report to the Head of Procurement & Inventory, acting as the architect of our operational procurement function and building the scalable systems we need to grow. We are a team that "cares wildly" about impact. Working closely with partners across the business, we ensure the infrastructure is in place to support their vision. Our focus is on delivering perfect availability, optimising inventory health, and enabling rapid range expansion through robust operational processes. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a function from the ground up and see your work directly fuel our success as we scale.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:56.title: Office Manager
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:56.description: Position Summary We are seeking a dependable, organized, and detail-oriented Office Manager to support the day-to-day operations of a small, growing roofing company. This position will be responsible for keeping office operations organized, maintaining subcontractor documentation, coordinating schedules, managing invoicing, and ensuring that all job-related costs and information are accurately entered and maintained in AccuLynx . The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working independently, communicates well with subcontractors and customers, and takes ownership of making sure paperwork, scheduling, and job information stay current and accurate. Key Responsibilities Subcontractor Management Maintain current and organized subcontractor files and documentation. Collect and track required subcontractor documents, including W-9s, certificates of insurance, licenses, agreements, and other required paperwork. Monitor expiration dates and follow up with subcontractors when updated documents are needed. Ensure subcontractors are properly documented before beginning work. Invoicing & Accounts Receivable Prepare and send customer invoices in a timely manner. Review completed work and job information to ensure invoices are accurate. Track outstanding invoices and follow up on past-due accounts as needed. Process and organize subcontractor invoices for completed work. Maintain accurate records of payments, invoices, and job expenses. Scheduling & Job Coordination Coordinate and maintain production schedules for roofing projects. Schedule subcontractors, materials, inspections, deliveries, and other job-related activities. Communicate schedule changes with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and management. Keep job statuses and important dates updated in AccuLynx. Help ensure jobs move efficiently from sold to completed. AccuLynx & Job Costing Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer and job information in AccuLynx. Enter material costs and other job expenses into AccuLynx. Review jobs for missing costs, documents, invoices, and other information. Keep job costing information organized and accurate. Upload and maintain relevant documents, photos, invoices, and records within the appropriate jobs. Assist management with job-cost and profitability reporting. General Office Administration Answer phones, emails, and general office inquiries. Communicate professionally with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and insurance/industry contacts. Maintain organized electronic and paper records. Assist the owner and management team with administrative tasks as needed. Identify missing information or potential issues and follow through until they are resolved. Help establish and maintain efficient office procedures as the company grows. Qualifications Previous office management, administrative, construction, roofing, or related experience preferred. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Comfortable working with numbers, invoices, and job costs. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficient with email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and basic computer systems. Experience with AccuLynx is strongly preferred, but training may be provided. Ability to prioritize multiple jobs and deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Dependable, proactive, and able to work independently. Construction or roofing industry experience is a plus. Ideal Candidate The right person for this position is someone who takes ownership, follows through, and keeps things from falling through the cracks . They should enjoy organization, be comfortable communicating with different types of people, and understand that accurate paperwork and timely follow-up are critical to keeping a roofing company profitable and running smoothly.
